newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Egypt says peace ball in Netanyahu court.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says peace ball in Netanyahu court.

text.p: Egypt's Foreign Minister Amr Moussa said Israel should make the first move to mobilise peace talks with Arabs, the Kuwait News Agency said on Thursday.

"The first step should be made by Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu by stopping the erection of the settlement in East Jerusalem," it quoted him as saying at the end of a visit to Kuwait. "This is a point of international consensus."
Netanyahu's decision to allow building to start last month on Jewish settlements in East Jerusalem angered Palestinians.
Moussa called it a "dangerous setback to the peace process."

Netanyahu said on his return from the White House on Tuesday faltering peace efforts could be salvaged, but he insisted that President Yasser Arafat should crack down on Palestinian militants before any U.S-mediated solution could be implemented.
A Palestinian team is holding talks in Washington with U.S. officials following the talks between President Bill Clinton and Netanyahu.
